title: Stalk of a tensor product of modules, and germs of tensor products of sections
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with tensor product $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] (the sheafification of $U\mapsto\mathcal F(U)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X(U)}\mathcal G(U)$); for an open $U$ and $s\in\mathcal F(U)$, $t\in\mathcal G(U)$ write $s\otimes t\in(\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)(U)$ for the image of $s\otimes t$ under the sheafification map. Then for every $x\in X$ there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules
$$(\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)_x\;\cong\;\mathcal F_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\mathcal G_x,$$
natural in $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$, under which the germ $(s\otimes t)_x$ (for $x\in U$) corresponds to $s_x\otimes t_x$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 17.16.1 (Tag 01CB, label lemma-stalk-tensor-product; proof omitted in the source: stalks are colimits over neighbourhoods, sheafification does not change stalks, and tensor products commute with filtered colimits); compare Sheaves, Lemma Tag 008B (lemma-stalk-tensor-sheaf-modules) for the change-of-rings case
